item.title: One injured, driver arrested on DUI charges after crash on I-64 in Lexington
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (ABC36 NEWS NOW) — One person was injured and another arrested following a late Sunday night crash on I-64 westbound near Haley Pike, according to the Lexington Police Department. Police say two vehicles were involved in the collision. One driver was taken to a local hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. item.title: Former FCPS superintendent passes away
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (ABC36 NEWS NOW) — Fayette County Public Schools is mourning the death of former Superintendent Tom Shelton, according to a statement released by the district.
